question: How long do bank withdrawals take after approval?

top_k.chunk_text:
Withdrawal requests submitted before 17:00 UTC are usually reviewed on the same business day.
Bank withdrawals may take 1 to 3 business days after approval.
E-wallet withdrawals are usually completed within 4 hours after approval.
Withdrawals are sent to the same payment method used for the deposit where possible.

To verify your address, upload a utility bill, bank statement or official government letter.
Documents must show your full name and residential address and be dated within the last 6 months.
Mobile phone bills and screenshots are not accepted as proof of address.

Demo accounts use virtual funds and are intended for practice only.
Profits made on a demo account cannot be withdrawn or transferred to a real account.
You can reset your demo balance to 10,000 USD at any time from the account dashboard.
Address verification is usually completed within 1 business day of upload.

question: My password reset link from yesterday isn't working. What should I do?

top_k.chunk_text:
To reset your password, select "Forgot password" on the login page and enter your registered email.
The password reset link is valid for 30 minutes after it is sent.
If the reset link has expired, request a new link from the login page.

If two-factor authentication is enabled, you also need a code from your authenticator app or one of your backup codes.
If backup codes are unavailable, contact customer support to verify your identity.
